title: One-Way Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: One-way confidentiality agreement protecting a single disclosing party's information.
when_needed: When only your company is sharing confidential information with the other side.

transforms.find: solely to [<mark>enable Recipient</mark> to <mark>evaluate or pursue a business relationship with the Company</mark>]
transforms.replace: solely to <mark>enable Recipient</mark> to <mark>evaluate or pursue a business relationship with the Company</mark>
